title: Kramerius IIIF gateway — per-library settings
description: The file IIIF_LIBRARIES_FILE points at. With IIIF_REGISTRY_URL also set this is an overlay and every field is optional; without it, each entry is the whole declaration and needs at least a url and a version. That distinction cannot be expressed here, because it depends on the environment — check.sh says so.

propertyNames.description: A registry code — lowercase — or a _-prefixed note.

^_.description: A note. The gateway skips _-prefixed codes, so this must not be checked as a library — the generator used to park its _excluded list here.

library.description: Anything omitted comes from the registry, except `catalogue`, which falls back to the mapping bundled in the jar.

url.description: The Kramerius API base, no trailing slash. Only when it is not where the registry says: a test host, or an instance mid-migration.

version.description: Rarely useful. The gateway asks each instance at /info and prefers that answer; this is the fallback for one that does not reply.

name.description: Merged over the registry's PER LANGUAGE TAG. The registry carries exactly two — the institution's own language and English — so this is the only way to add a third or correct one.

propertyNames.description: A BCP 47 tag. An untagged name is refused: a name with the wrong language on it is a false claim a viewer acts on.

rps.description: Requests per second against THIS institution's image server, overriding IIIF_UPSTREAM_RPS. The knob to reach for after an institution asks you to ease off. 0 disables pacing for it.

catalogue.description: Where this library's indexed system numbers resolve in a catalogue. Overrides the mapping bundled in the jar, which carries MZK's — the only one anyone has verified.

url.description: The record URL, with {id} where the record identifier goes. Without the placeholder there is nowhere to put the number, which is why it is required here rather than discovered at the first manifest.

rules.description: Ordered; first match wins, and nothing matching means no link at all — a wrong catalogue link looks to a reader like a record the gateway found.

pattern.description: Matched against the whole indexed system number. MUST capture the record number in group 1 — a pattern with no group is rejected at startup, because it cannot be applied.

prefix.description: Put in front of the captured number verbatim, so it carries its own separator. Empty means the catalogue takes a bare number.

^_.description: Notes. Ignored by the gateway, so anything goes.
